messages:
Sam Lee: Hey folks — quick onboarding question: where should I post different kinds of first-week stuff? e.g. laptop/badge issues, VPN/access problems, SDK questions, and also how to stop noisy bot posts in channels?
Priya Nair: Welcome Sam! TL;DR: hardware/badge -> #people-ops, access & VPN -> #eng-infra or #help, SDK/dev-tools -> #devex, product/feature questions -> #product. Announcements/alerts only in #announcements. Use threads for follow-ups. :wave:
Miguel Torres: For noisy bot posts: you can mute the channel (Channel header -> Notifications -> Mute channel) or tweak channel notifications to only @mentions. Some bots support per-channel subscriptions but that's hit-or-miss.
Jules Park: Also: when you report infra issues, include a short reproducible snippet and use a code block for logs so folks can scan quickly. Example: ```
Error: failed to fetch creds
Steps:
1) ssh vpn.company.com
2) run `setup_vpn`
Output: connection timeout
```
Priya Nair: Good call. For access requests, ping @devops or post in #eng-infra with the template below — it speeds up triage: ```
Who: Sam Lee (sam@redwood.com)
What: VPN access + GCP project X
Why: onboarding + dev work
When: asap
```
Miguel Torres: If it's a deploy noise problem, ask in that channel if the team can send deploys to #release-war-room instead, or adjust deploy-bot config. If you need to stop getting direct messages from a bot, open the bot's profile -> more -> mute.
Jules Park: Quick etiquette tips: 1) use threads not DMs for team-helpable issues, 2) react with :eyes: or :thumbsup: to acknowledge, 3) avoid #general for questions — that's for company-wide notices.
Onboarding Bot: Hi Sam! Welcome to Redwood Inference :tada: Helpful links: Getting started doc - https://internal.redwood.com/onboarding, Badge request form - https://internal.redwood.com/people-ops/badge, Devex handbook - https://internal.redwood.com/devex. Reply `help` to this bot for one-click subscriptions.
Sam Lee: Awesome, thanks everyone! I'll post VPN in #eng-infra and SDK questions in #devex. One more: should I DM someone for GitHub repo access or post in #eng-infra?
Priya Nair: Post in #eng-infra with the template — keeps permissions audits clear. If it's a repo-specific owner matter, mention them in the thread. :white_check_mark:
